metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - "UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY" - Date: January 2021 (2021-01-01 to 2021-01-31) - Location: Namibia (need to define geometry for Namibia) 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is a precipitation product with no clouds to mask - Simply sum daily precipitation over January 2021 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total precipitation = 0 mm (drought) → Answer B - C1: No images in collection - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Result is None/NaN or invalid (e.g., negative precipitation) - A: Total > 7 inches (177.8 mm) - B: Total ≤ 7 inches Note: 7 inches = 177.8 mm ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Define Namibia boundary namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[11.7, -17.0], [25.3, -17.0], [25.3, -29.0], [11.7, -29.0], [11.7, -17.0]] ]) start_date = '2021-01-01' end_date = '2021-02-01' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(namibia) num_images = chirps.size().getInfo() print(f"CHIRPS images found: {num_images}") if num_images == 0: print("No precipitation data for January 2021.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over January total_precip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum() # Check pixel count pixel_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=namibia, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) pixel_count = pixel_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo() print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}") if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid pixels in Namibia.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculate mean precipitation across Namibia mean_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=namibia, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) mean_precip_mm = mean_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if mean_precip_mm is None or mean_precip_mm < 0: print("Invalid precipitation value.") print("C3") else: # Convert to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) mean_precip_inches = mean_precip_mm / 25.4 threshold_inches = 7.0 print(f"Mean total precipitation: {mean_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({mean_precip_inches:.2f} inches)") print(f"Threshold: {threshold_inches} inches ({threshold_inches * 25.4:.2f} mm)") if mean_precip_inches > threshold_inches: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Define Namibia boundary
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[11.7, -17.0], [25.3, -17.0], [25.3, -29.0], [11.7, -29.0], [11.7, -17.0]]
])

start_date = '2021-01-01'
end_date = '2021-02-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(namibia)

num_images = chirps.size().getInfo()
print(f"CHIRPS images found: {num_images}")

if num_images == 0:
    print("No precipitation data for January 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over January
    total_precip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # Check pixel count
    pixel_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=namibia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    pixel_count = pixel_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in Namibia.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculate mean precipitation across Namibia
        mean_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=namibia,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        mean_precip_mm = mean_stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if mean_precip_mm is None or mean_precip_mm < 0:
            print("Invalid precipitation value.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Convert to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
            mean_precip_inches = mean_precip_mm / 25.4
            threshold_inches = 7.0
            
            print(f"Mean total precipitation: {mean_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({mean_precip_inches:.2f} inches)")
            print(f"Threshold: {threshold_inches} inches ({threshold_inches * 25.4:.2f} mm)")
            
            if mean_precip_inches > threshold_inches:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
